Journal of Sichuan University is a comprehensive peer-reviewed open-access medical scientific journal sponsored by the Sichuan University .

The journal was established in 1959. Journal of Sichuan University (Medical Science Edition), a bimonthly scientific journal publishing peer-reviewed research in the field of medicine in general, it is distributed among readers in China and other countries.

The Journal publishes recent advances and the latest research findings in clinical medicine, basic medical sciences, pharmacology, preventive medicine, dentistry and interdisciplinary fields of medicine. By publishing papers on applied, basic and clinical research, the journal aims to contribute to academic exchanges in China and abroad/all countries, promote and develop health care and medicine.

We publish papers in the following scientific area:

Clinical Medicine, Epidemiologic Studies, Health Improvement Strategies, Laboratory and Biochemistry, Animal Investigation, Pharmacology, Pathogenesis of Disease and Molecular Biology, Genetics.

ABOUT JOURNAL

Journal of Sichuan University is a comprehensive medical scientific journal sponsored by the Association of Education of the People’s Republic of China and Sichuan Medical Association. The purpose of this journal is to reflect the medical and health scientific research achievements.
